answers: The script runs pg_dump inside the app-db container with --format=custom and writes the output to a .part file, which is then renamed to .dump.
A find command deletes files matching app_*.dump in the backup directory whose age is 7 days or more (-mtime +6), after a successful backup.
On a separate test container (app-db-restore-test) started from the same image as app-db, with no published port, not on the production database.
